releaseNotesMarkdown:
### VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics (victoriametrics/vmagent)

### [`v1.157.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.157.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.156.0...v1.157.0)

#### [v1.157.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.157.0)

Released at 2026-11-20

**Update Note 1:** `vmctl` in [vm-native](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/) mode: `--vm-native-filter-time-end` is now a required parameter. See [#​11830](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11830) for details.

**Update Note 2:** [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) change for [Vultr service discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#vultr_sd_configs): Vultr service discovery params now should be provided via `vultr_sd_configs` field. Previously, vmagent was expecting `vultr_configs` field to be set, which didn't match vmagent's documentation and Prometheus service discovery settings for Vultr. See [#​11950](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11950) for details.

- SECURITY: upgrade Go builder from Go1.27.3 to Go1.27.4. See [the list of issues addressed in Go1.27.4](https://redirect.github.com/golang/go/issues?q=milestone%3AGo1.27.4%20label%3ACherryPickApproved).

- FEATURE: [docs/integrations](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/): add [integration with Nightingale](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/nightingale/), a monitoring and alerting platform that uses VictoriaMetrics as a datasource and remote storage. See [#​11886](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11886). Thanks to [@​710leo](https://redirect.github.com/710leo) for the contribution.

- FEATURE: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): restart only the changed aggregation configs on [config reload](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/configuration/#configuration-update). A config is considered unchanged only if it stays identical and keeps its position in the config file. Previously, any change in the config file reset the aggregation state of all the configs. See [#​4810](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/4810).

- FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): add `-datasource.queryTimeout` command-line flag to limit the duration of a single request to `-datasource.url` and `-remoteRead.url`. By default, rule evaluation queries time out after the group's evaluation interval. Previously, a datasource response with a stalled body could block the group evaluation forever. See [#​11940](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11940).

- FEATURE: [vmalert-tool](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert-tool/): add `-respectGroupInterval` command-line flag to evaluate every rule group on its own `interval` instead of the file-wide `evaluation_interval`, the same way vmalert does. Groups without `interval` keep using `evaluation_interval`. The flag is disabled by default. See [#​11383](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11383). Thanks [@​evkuzin](https://redirect.github.com/evkuzin) for contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmctl](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/): allow resuming interrupted migrations in [vm-native mode](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/). vmctl tracks finished requests in a state file in the `--state-dir` directory (the current working directory by default), and a repeated run with the same flags continues the progress. `--vm-native-filter-time-end` is now required, so resumed runs migrate the same time range. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmctl/victoriametrics/#resuming-migration). See [issue #​11763](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11763) and [change #​11830](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11830) for details.

- FEATURE: `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): add `-rpc.compressLevel` command-line flag for configuring the zstd compression level used for internal protocol to `vmstorage` (default `1`). See [#​11934](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11934).

- FEATURE: [vmrestore](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmrestore/): add `-restoreSince` and `-restorePartitions` command-line flags for restoring only a subset of monthly partitions from a backup. This reduces download time and disk usage when only part of the data is needed, e.g. when restoring a few production partitions into a test environment. Local partitions in `-storageDataPath` that aren't restored are removed. Partial restore never restores the legacy non-partitioned IndexDB from before [v1.133.0](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/changelog/#v11330), and fails if the backup contains it unless `-allowPartialRestoreWithoutLegacyIndex` is set. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmrestore/#partial-restore) and [#​10916](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10916). Thanks to [@​AshwinRamaniPsg](https://redirect.github.com/AshwinRamaniPsg) for the contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and [vmutils](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/#components): publish release archives for Windows on arm64 (`victoria-metrics-windows-arm64-*.zip` and `vmutils-windows-arm64-*.zip`). See [#​8514](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/8514). Thanks to [@​fiodortretyakov](https://redirect.github.com/fiodortretyakov) for contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): accept the Prometheus `lookback_delta` query arg as an alias of `max_lookback` in `/api/v1/query`, `/api/v1/query_range` and `/federate`. `max_lookback` takes precedence if both are set. See [#​11710](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11710). Thanks to [@​muhadyan](https://redirect.github.com/muhadyan) for contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmauth](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/): add `src_headers_match_all` and `src_query_args_match_all` options to `url_map`. When set to `true`, a request is routed to the given `url_prefix` only if it matches all the `src_headers` or `src_query_args` entries, instead of at least one of them. This allows routing by several headers at once, e.g. `AccountID` and `ProjectID`. See [routing by header](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#routing-by-header), [routing by query arg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmauth/#routing-by-query-arg) and [#​11961](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11961).

- FEATURE: [Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): add `merge_latest_label` query arg param, which applies updates to the original time series based on specified label. See [these docs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#series-updates). See [#​3992](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/3992).

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: correctly match regular expressions of the form `.+text.+` (used in [relabeling](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/relabeling/) rules and series label filters) when `text` appears at the start of the matched string. Previously such series could be silently dropped, for example `foofoox` did not match `.+foo.+`. See [#​11941](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11941). Thanks to [@​amalsaidov](https://redirect.github.com/amalsaidov) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): drop the incomplete first aggregation interval after the start by default. Previously, samples received before the first interval boundary were merged into the next interval, so the first flushed value could cover up to two intervals. See [flush time alignment](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#flush-time-alignment) and [#​11964](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11964).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): properly recover after a flush that takes longer than the aggregation or deduplication interval. Previously, such a flush could permanently shift aggregation results one interval into the future, and with [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) or [ignore_old_samples](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#ignoring-old-samples) enabled, all incoming samples were dropped as too old until restart. See [#​11904](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11904).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): stop aggregation and deduplication with [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) enabled without waiting for the flush delay. Previously, graceful shutdown could hang until the pending flush delay elapsed. See [#​11958](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11958).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): respect `-remoteWrite.streamAggr.enableWindows` for [deduplication](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#deduplication) configured via `-remoteWrite.streamAggr.dedupInterval`. Previously, the per-URL deduplicator used the global `-streamAggr.enableWindows` flag instead. See [#​11969](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11969).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): correctly parse [Vultr service discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#vultr_sd_configs) configuration provided via field `vultr_sd_configs`. Previously, vmagent was expecting `vultr_configs` field to be set, even though documentation was explicitly mentioning `vultr_sd_configs` field. The `vultr_sd_configs` field also matches [Prometheus service discovery settings for Vultr](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#vultr_sd_config). The bug was introduced in
  [v1.102.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.102.0). See [#​6041](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/6041).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): fix unexpected process panic when specifying filters like `label`, `hostname`, etc. for [Vultr service discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#vultr_sd_configs). The bug was introduced in
  [v1.102.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.102.0). See [#​6041](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/6041).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): prevent HTTP connection leaks when [service discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/) configs are reloaded or removed for Hetzner, Marathon, PuppetDB and Vultr SDs. See [#​4724](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/4724).

- BUGFIX: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): properly reload [Marathon service discovery](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#marathon_sd_configs) configuration on scrape config reloads. Previously, discovered Marathon targets could remain active even if configuration has changed. The bug was introduced in
  [v1.109.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.109.0). See [#​6642](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/6642).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): correctly serve concurrent JSON and CSV [export API](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#how-to-export-time-series) requests with mixed `reduce_mem_usage=0` and `reduce_mem_usage=1` settings. Previously, responses could be corrupted. See [#​11912](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11912).

- BUGFIX: `vminsert` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly calculate `vmstorage` node saturation used by [slowness based re-routing](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/#slowness-based-re-routing) on platforms with low timer resolution, e.g. Windows. Previously, the saturation could permanently become `NaN` when sends to `vmstorage` completed within a single timer tick. See [#​11937](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11937). Thanks to [@​mikepop7](https://redirect.github.com/mikepop7) for the contribution.
